facts.text: Don't ask whose dream this dinner is in. Eat fast, and watch for the kick.
facts.why: Cobb never says this. His real lines are about dreams feeling real, and Eames has a short line that suits a menu.
facts.fix: It's perfectly possible. Just bloody difficult.
